versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-sre-toolkit, an advanced SRE skill for Alibaba Cloud diagnosis and health management.

- Provides end-to-end Alibaba Cloud SRE workflows for diagnosis, inspection, capacity planning, incident response, and security audit.
- Enforces a strict, read-only diagnostic workflow via STAROps digital employees, with detailed CRITICAL RULES to prevent missteps and unauthorized operations.
- CLI fallback supported only under tightly controlled, explicitly defined conditions.
- Absolute restrictions on using the Aliyun CLI: only allowed for read-only commands, never for write operations.
- Mandatory, non-negotiable command sequence required for any SRE or troubleshooting workflow.
- Includes detailed instructions and security provisions for installation, authentication, and report generation.
